title: EXCELLENT Girona and Besalu Tour guide and driver!!!!
text:
Without a doubt our experience with this tour company was incredible and our favorite day trip  while visiting Barcelona!
After months of planning a vacation for a family of 6 (including 3 little kids), we decided for this tour. The company texted me the day before to confirm the reservation and to provide contact details of our driver. The morning of, we were warmly welcomed by Alex who arrived early at our hotel for pickup. He was TRULY great! Van was spacious, clean and he made the drive from Barcelona to Girona extremely pleasant. We were off to a great start!
